name: 19129 · Philadelphia, PA
findings: ZIP 19129 (Philadelphia) has 63 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19129 (Philadelphia) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 19129 (Philadelphia) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 41% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 42 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
